skill.sparkwitch.ceremonial_sword.name: Ceremonial Sword
skill.sparkwitch.ceremonial_sword.descri: Complete 2 tasks to permanently receive a Ceremonial Sword for this round, free of mana cost, while keeping your knives. Either hand: +40% movement speed (does not stack). Main hand: attack speed 2 and +2 blocks of attack reach. Left-click and dash kills share a 30-second kill cooldown; right-click dash has its own 5-second cooldown and still moves you while killing is unavailable.
skill.sparkwitch.mighty_force.name: Mighty Force
skill.sparkwitch.mighty_force.descriptio: Spend 60 mana. For 10 seconds, an empty-hand left click knocks a player back and makes one lethal attack. Killing an innocent follows the server's shoot-innocent punishment: you die too, or you lose Mighty Force for the round.
skill.sparkwitch.swift_step.name: Swift Step
skill.sparkwitch.swift_step.description: Two charges, 20 mana each, for 5 seconds of Speed III; each spent charge returns on its own after 20 seconds.
skill.sparkwitch.murder_sense.name: Murder Sense
skill.sparkwitch.murder_sense.descriptio: Spend 40 mana to highlight players within 20 blocks (30 after graduating) who are holding dangerous items in red for 15 seconds.
skill.sparkwitch.healing.name: Healing
skill.sparkwitch.healing.description: Spend 30 mana to restore 3 sanity per second to innocent players within 8 blocks for 20 seconds; inside the aura, Fear cannot block their skills or instinct.
skill.sparkwitch.clairvoyance.name: Clairvoyance
skill.sparkwitch.clairvoyance.descriptio: Spend 50 mana to highlight other living players in white for 10 seconds; in exchange, everyone sees you in pale blue for 10 seconds.
skill.sparkwitch.purify.name: Purify
skill.sparkwitch.purify.description: Unlocked after graduating; use it with the secondary key. Spend 30 mana to remove the Witch Factor from the player you aim at within 6 blocks (or from yourself when you aim at no one and carry one) and gain 30 mana; a target without a factor is reported as such. 20-second cooldown; Fear does not block it.
skill.sparkwitch.death_ray.name: 死亡射线
skill.sparkwitch.death_ray.description: 消耗 100 点魔力值，10 秒内左键可发射 3 次红色射线，范围 12 格，墙体会阻挡射线。

guidebook.sparkassist.noellesroles.waite: Carries a second serving to feed others and earns an extra 50 coins for each eating or drinking task it completes for them; anyone who finishes a task shows through walls for 30 seconds.
guidebook.sparkassist.noellesroles.toxic: Identifies poison, cures poisoned players, and uses cooldown reductions plus shop refreshes to deploy antidotes more often.
guidebook.sparkassist.noellesroles.recal: Marks a recall point and spends money to return, backed by passive income and mobility shop tools.
guidebook.sparkassist.noellesroles.coron: Examines bodies, earns money near corpses, and uses body bags to unlock corpse-identity disguises.
guidebook.sparkassist.noellesroles.phant: Uses the backpack to select another living player and make them invisible for 30 seconds; the backpack ability has an independent 90-second cooldown.
guidebook.sparkassist.noellesroles.silen: Silences the specified Wathe knife, revolver, and bat sounds, including when a Coroner uses a Silencer disguise.

skill.sparkwitch.ceremonial_sword.protec: Pierces shields and parries, but still consumes protections and triggers retaliation. A protected Witch Maiden can die with the Grand Witch. The crosshair bar shows attack recharge, not dash or kill cooldown; gray means killing is unavailable. Trait-based protections, including Last Stand and Last Escape, are not bypassed.
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.name: Witch Factor
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.descriptio: Primary ability (default G): spend 50 mana to spread a factor to a living player within 8 unobstructed blocks; 20s cooldown. Both casters share a cumulative first-spread quota, default floor(opening players / 3). One factor per player; removal never refunds quota.
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.income: Factors from either caster grant each living Grand Witch 25 mana every 30s, or 40 from an Apprentice Witch and 60 from a Murderous Witch. Factors survive their source's death.
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.sanity: After 20s, new or inheriting holders receive a warning and join the blue-purple outline network. All instinct outlines and hiding rules take precedence. Holders with real sanity lose 10 sanity every 60s, or 30 for an Apprentice Witch.
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.transfer: On a player kill, transfer to an eligible killer, preserving income/sanity clocks but restarting the 20s admission delay. Grand Witch, Bewitched, Accomplice, Witch Maiden, Voodoo and Emma cannot carry factors. Environmental deaths, invalid or already marked killers remove the factor without refunding quota.

skill.sparkwitch.emma_factor.name: Witch Factor
skill.sparkwitch.emma_factor.description: Primary ability: spend 100 mana to spread a shared factor within 8 blocks; 20s cooldown. Regenerate 1 mana per second up to 100; tasks grant 20 and may exceed that cap.
skill.sparkwitch.emma_factor.backlash: Attempting to mark a Grand Witch, Bewitched, Accomplice or Witch Maiden kills you after 20s by Factor Backlash. Voodoo instead costs half your maximum sanity after 20s. These targets receive no factor.
skill.sparkwitch.emma_factor.gun: A revolver kill on a carrier reduces this shot cycle's cooldown by 90% and grants Speed III for 2s. Niko bursts reward only once. Innocent-shot penalties still apply.
skill.sparkwitch.emma_factor.network: Once mature living carriers reach half the quota, gain Speed I until death or round end. Unlimited mode uses half the opening player count.
message.sparkwitch.emma.no_capacity: The shared first-spread quota is exhausted for this round.
